visual_goal: Show the impact graph as a forward closure from superseded readings through derived facts to artifacts and finally to the audiences who must be told.
prompt: A left-to-right flow in four vertical bands. Far left: a stack of gauge cards labeled 'Superseded readings'. One arrow from it into a gear box labeled 'Derived facts'. From 'Derived facts' exactly three arrows fan out to three icons stacked in the middle band: a closed plain ledger book labeled 'Valuations', a report document labeled 'Reports', and an advert card with a car outline labeled 'Adverts'. Below them, in the same middle band, a fourth icon, a small document labeled 'API answers'; it has exactly two incoming arrows: one long arrow along the bottom from 'Superseded readings', and one short arrow down from 'Valuations'. In the right band, three groups of generic figures, each with exactly one incoming arrow: from 'Reports' to 'Dealers and consumers', from 'Adverts' to 'Portals', from 'API answers' to 'Data clients'. No arrow skips the middle band. The ledger, report and advert icons carry no writing or digits, only plain lines.
alt: Superseded readings feed derived facts, which feed valuations, reports and adverts; readings also feed API answers; reports reach dealers and consumers, adverts reach portals and API answers reach data clients.

visual_goal: Show the correction journey: containment before the supplier fix, the correction fanning out through the backbone, Retrace tracking the impact and closing the case.
prompt: A sequence diagram drawn as an illustration. Across the top, six evenly spaced headers, each an icon above a label: a delivery truck 'Kilometra', a funnel 'Inlet', a filing cabinet 'Tracewell', a magnifier over a clipboard 'Retrace', a horizontal pipe 'Event backbone', a cluster of boxes 'Consumers'. Under the center of each header a thin vertical dashed lifeline runs down the image. Six horizontal arrows, each starting on one lifeline and ending with its arrowhead touching another lifeline, from top to bottom: an orange arrow from the 'Retrace' lifeline left to the 'Tracewell' lifeline labeled 'dispute'; an arrow from the 'Kilometra' lifeline to the 'Inlet' lifeline labeled 'redelivery'; an arrow from the 'Inlet' lifeline to the 'Tracewell' lifeline labeled 'corrected records'; an arrow from the 'Tracewell' lifeline to the 'Event backbone' lifeline labeled 'corrected'; an arrow from the 'Event backbone' lifeline to the 'Consumers' lifeline labeled 're-derive'; a green arrow from the 'Consumers' lifeline left to the 'Retrace' lifeline labeled 'completion'. At the bottom of the 'Retrace' lifeline, a green checkmark stamp labeled 'Close'. No grid, no table cells.
alt: Swimlanes for Kilometra, Inlet, Tracewell, Retrace, the event backbone and consumers: Retrace disputes the readings first, the redelivery lands, the correction fans out through the backbone, consumers report completion and Retrace closes the case.
